purpose: Store worksheets, assignments, and games for students.

courseId.description: ID of the course this activity belongs to.

topicId.description: ID of the curriculum topic this activity is linked to.

url.description: URL to access the activity (e.g., PDF, game link).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the activity was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the activity was last updated.

access_patterns.teacher: read/write if courseId matches their assigned course
access_patterns.parent: read if child is enrolled in the course
access_patterns.lp: read if assigned to the course

composite_indexes_needed.description: For querying activities by course and topic.

validation_rules: type must be one of the predefined types.
courseId and topicId must reference valid documents.
performance_notes: Ensure efficient querying by course and topic for teacher dashboards.
